description: Make the Friday event countdown's remaining-day value substantially more prominent and easy to scan.
steps: Strengthen the visual hierarchy of the Friday countdown while preserving honest wedding-date messaging.
Keep the countdown responsive, dark-mode compatible, reduced-motion friendly, and accessible.
Update regression tests and production validation, then verify at narrow and desktop widths.
acceptance_criteria: The remaining-day value for Friday is substantially larger and easier to scan than its supporting label.
Countdown wording remains accurate before, during, and after the Friday wedding date.
The countdown remains readable and responsive in light and dark modes and at narrow and desktop widths.
Production validation and all automated tests pass.
verification: Inspect the countdown in light and dark themes at narrow and desktop widths
findings: Reworked the hero countdown into a separate responsive value and supporting label, with the remaining-day value scaling from 52px at 320px to 92px at 1280px while its label remains 12.16px to 14.4px. The atomic polite live region preserves a useful no-JavaScript Friday date and JavaScript now gives accurate before, on-Friday, and post-event messaging. Production validation passed and all 23 Node tests passed. Real-browser checks at 320px and 1280px confirmed the countdown fits without horizontal overflow, remains prominent in light and dark modes, and preserves readable supporting text. No Dockerfile exists.
